svg.title: Snowy Friends — step 5: Introduce your snowy friend
svg.desc: Look at your creature from a few sides and reshape any part you want. Name it, photograph it and try a small companion. Different-sized ears, a crooked smile or an uneven shell can make your friend special. Gather loose details and head inside for a warm-up break.
